entities.name: PMID:25083175
observations: 2014 randomized placebo-controlled pilot trial of metformin 1500 mg/day, NAC 1800 mg/day, both, or placebo in PCOS patients undergoing ICSI; 80 randomized and 20 dropped out.

Compared with placebo, combination therapy lowered malondialdehyde, insulin, and leptin, but did not significantly lower LH, total testosterone, cholesterol, or triglycerides; small pilot with attrition.

entities.name: PMID:25482371
observations: Randomized placebo-controlled pilot trial in PCOS patients undergoing ICSI found NAC alone reduced immature/abnormal oocytes and increased good-quality embryos versus placebo; combination therapy lowered MDA and leptin, but abstract does not report improved clinical pregnancy/live birth from combination.

entities.name: Mixed biomarker response to MET+NAC
observations: In a small PCOS-ICSI pilot, MET+NAC reduced MDA, insulin, and leptin versus placebo but showed no significant reduction in LH, testosterone, cholesterol, or triglycerides; clinical manifestation benefit was not established.
